technique_name: Collaborate with a fellow learner to create a plan for making a mini catapult.
description: Our plan for making a mini catapult requires five materials: a length of balsa wood, two thin wooden dowels, three rubber bands, a piece of fabric, and glue. We would need to cut the balsa wood into four pieces - two of them measuring fifteen cm in length, and the other two measuring twelve cm in length.
